1804 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
02-21-1804 minus 145 days:  
January has 31 days, so back to Jan 21 is 31 days (Feb 21 → Jan 21).  
From Jan 21, need 145 - 31 = 114 more days back.  
Dec 31, 1803 is 21 days before Jan 21 (Jan has 31 days, so Jan 21 → Dec 31, 1803 is 21 days earlier in Dec).  
Remaining 114 - 21 = 93 days before Dec 31, 1803.  
November 30 is 31 days before Dec 31 → 62 days left.  
October 31 is 30 days before Nov 30 → 32 days left.  
September 30 is 31 days before Oct 31 → 1 day left.  
So 1 day before Sep 30 is Sep 29, 1803.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1803-09-29
